status: preregistered before the R53 server launch
finding_that_motivated_this_test: R52A exceeded 50 tok/s and matched both independent R51 targets 12/12, but independent fresh-cache replays R52B and R52C matched only 7/12 and 6/12. R52A versus R52C had seven semantically different .best_config selections: three pointwise kernels and four reduction kernels selected different launch shapes. Generated kernel metadata recorded deterministic=false even though the container received TORCHINDUCTOR_DETERMINISTIC=1, showing that the environment-only control did not reach vLLM's effective Inductor compilation context.
treatment: Keep the content-verified R50 image, official FP8 model, TP2, W8A16, MTP depth 1, XPU Graph off, persistent GDN state, packed Gemma RMSNorm exact replay, seed 0, max-autotune=0, coordinate-descent=0, combo_kernels=false, and benchmark_combo_kernel=false fixed. In the explicit vLLM inductor_compile_config also set deterministic=true, triton.autotune_pointwise=false, and benchmark_epilogue_fusion=false so generated kernels cannot benchmark alternative numerically distinct pointwise/reduction launch shapes.
workload: Fresh server and empty compile cache; complete fixed 12-prompt/six-class natural-512 suite; each prompt once; temperature 0; class-balanced 100-event/99-interval decode; prefix cache disabled; cached_tokens=0; complete raw token arrays; independent canaries.
screen_gate: The attempt must pass every workload/cache/canary gate, generated kernel metadata must record deterministic=true and autotune_pointwise=false, all .best_config files must be absent or resolve to a single fixed configuration, the output must match both independent R51 target attempts 12/12, and speed must exceed 50 tok/s before replication. If it passes, run a second fresh candidate and require the full two-target-by-two-candidate cross-product to remain 12/12.
reporting: No headline, package promotion, or external submission from one attempt, a compiled-cache replay, favorable prompts, tolerance matching, or a sub-512 fixture. Preserve negative evidence.
